title: Date Surcharges on Re-Rated Visits — Personal Services Plan Calendar Schedule
content:
When an hourly charge for a delivered visit under the Personal Services Plan is re-rated, the billable hours of a visit delivered on a date in the Larkspur holiday calendar are increased by the package's holiday surcharge percentage, those of a visit delivered on any other Saturday or Sunday are increased by the package's weekend surcharge percentage, and those of any other visit are not increased. The visit date is the date recorded on the visit's own service order. The billable hours are rounded to two decimal places half up only after the increase has been applied, never earlier.

## Percentages by tier

| Tier | Visit on a Larkspur holiday | Visit on a Saturday or Sunday that is not a Larkspur holiday | Any other visit |
|---|---|---|---|
| Personal Services Pay-As-You-Go Plan | 50% | 25% | 0% |
| Personal Services Essentials Package | 50% | 25% | 0% |
| Personal Services Companion Package | 50% | 25% | 0% |
| Personal Services Comfort Package | 50% | 15% | 0% |
| Personal Services Premier Package | 25% | 10% | 0% |
| Personal Services Concierge Package | 25% | 0% | 0% |

## Larkspur holiday calendar

The holidays are New Year's Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving Day and Christmas Day, each on its calendar date:

| Holiday | 2025 | 2026 | 2027 |
|---|---|---|---|
| New Year's Day | 1 January (Wednesday) | 1 January (Thursday) | 1 January (Friday) |
| Memorial Day | 26 May (Monday) | 25 May (Monday) | 31 May (Monday) |
| Independence Day | 4 July (Friday) | 4 July (Saturday) | 4 July (Sunday) |
| Labor Day | 1 September (Monday) | 7 September (Monday) | 6 September (Monday) |
| Thanksgiving Day | 27 November (Thursday) | 26 November (Thursday) | 25 November (Thursday) |
| Christmas Day | 25 December (Thursday) | 25 December (Friday) | 25 December (Saturday) |

A holiday that falls on a Saturday or Sunday — 4 July 2026, 4 July 2027, 25 December 2027 — takes the holiday percentage, not the weekend percentage; the two are never added together.

## Worked examples (hypothetical billable hours)

- Comfort Package, a visit on Saturday 14 March 2026 with billable hours of 1.25: increased by 15%, 1.4375, rounded to 1.44 hours.
- Premier Package, a visit on Saturday 4 July 2026 with billable hours of 1.00: a holiday, increased by 25% to 1.25 hours.
- Concierge Package, a visit on Sunday 15 March 2026 with billable hours of 2.00: increased by 0%, so 2.00 hours.
- Any tier, a visit on Tuesday 17 March 2026: not increased.
